summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for auto-starting trace initialization with atexit handler registration and legacy session compatibility. It differs semantically from peer candidates (decorator instrumentation, SDK initialization, manual trace start) and existing skills (which cover OpenTelemetry/Flink, not AgentOps trace auto-start). No existing skill covers the specific capability of automatic trace session initialization with atexit handler idempotency and global reference management. Support evidence from Debugging Roadmap confirms this is a documented, non-conflicting capability.
